subject: general
question: A train crosses a platform of length 200 metres in 40 seconds and a man in 20 seconds. The length of the train is:
solution:
**Given:**

Length of the platform = 200 metres.

Time taken to cross the platform = 40 seconds.

Time taken to cross a man = 20 seconds.

**Formula Used:**

Speed = Distance / Time

Distance = Speed × Time

**Calculation:**

Let the length of the train be L metres.

Speed of the train = L / 20

When crossing the platform, the total distance covered = L + 200

Time taken = 40 seconds

Speed of the train = (L + 200) / 40

Since speed is constant, equate the speeds:

 (L)/(20) = (L + 200)/(40) 

⇒ 2L = L + 200

⇒ 2L - L = 200

⇒ L = 200

**The length of the train is 200 metres.**
